summary: Crescent Biopharma, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an underwritten public offering of ordinary shares and pre-funded warrants. The offering price is not yet set; the last sale price on Nasdaq (symbol CBIO) was $15.69 as of July 13, 2026. Proceeds will go to the company. Underwriters include Jefferies, TD Cowen, Guggenheim Securities, Cantor, and LifeSci Capital. The filing is a routine capital raise, not a special situation transaction.
